editionLabel: Thames & Kosmos English rules, 2018 edition with 6th expedition
firstPlayerRule: The oldest player begins. After that, the players alternate turns.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: A match is three games. In each later game, the player who has the most points goes first.
The long-game variant with six expeditions does not change who starts.

sources.title: Lost Cities: The Duel of the Explorers — rules

internalEvidence: Downloaded https://www.thamesandkosmos.com/manuals/full/691821_LC_Card_Game.pdf from the publisher Thames & Kosmos’ manuals folder (product 691821, Lost Cities Card Game with 6th Expedition). SHA-256: 66b2ce03a3998df96028f8028435372363f6af9671d9c55c7ae3a44ee6326d72. Read the extracted text of PDF pages 1–4. Page 2, Sequence of Play: ‘The oldest player begins. Afterward, the players alternate turns.’ Page 3: after scoring, start a new game; ‘This time, the player who has the most points goes first’; the winner is decided after three games; the six-expedition Long Game variant changes only the board and cards. Page 4 credits Reiner Knizia, © 1999, 2018 Franckh-Kosmos and © 2018 Thames & Kosmos, identifying the two-player Lost Cities card game (BGG 50). Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rulebook gives no tie-break for players of the same age.
For later games, the rules do not say whether “most points” means the previous game or the running total, or what to do if scores are tied.
